items.name: 1st-degree AV block
action: Benign conduction delay: monitor
Note AV-nodal blocking drugs; watch for progression in an MI
hints: Measure the PR interval on several beats.
Here's what I measure on this one: rate 87/min; rhythm regular; PR 0.34 s, constant (over 0.20 s); QRS narrow (0.07 s).
The PR is long but never changes, and no beats drop.
